question: In what year did Rust reach its first stable release, 1.0?

subquestions: What year was Rust 1.0 (its first stable release) released?

args.query: Official Rust blog Rust 1.0 released May 2015

    https://doc.rust-lang.org/edition-guide/rust-2015/index.html
    Rust 2015 Rust 2015 has a theme of "stability". It commenced with the release of 1.0, and is the "default edition". The edition system was conceived in late 2017, but Rust 1.0 was released in May of 2015. As such, 2015 is the edition that you get when you don't specify any particular edition, for backwards compatibility reasons.
